title: Pay as a share of manager pay
statementMd:
For every employee who has a manager, show their first name and their salary as a percentage of their manager's salary, rounded to 1 decimal.

Expected columns: `first_name`, `pct_of_manager`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Join employees to their managers and divide.
Multiply by 100.0 to get a percentage.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT e.first_name, ROUND(100.0 * e.salary / m.salary, 1) AS pct_of_manager FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON m.id = e.manager_id;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
